prose: A paper asks whether we can predict which jobs robots will do. Since many jobs are physical, AI's economic impact depends partly on robotics. The authors build a measure of job exposure to robots by using Claude to assess how well present-day robot capabilities match job tasks, arguing that listing current capabilities gives insight into the coming years. Based on the abstract.
highlights: Uses Claude to rate task-capability fit
Argues enumerating today's capabilities helps forecasting
Physical jobs matter for AI's economic impact
